This is my fav episode by far. It looks more like a family reunion rather than a show. Yeongja and Ssuk are the mom and noona cooking for kids, Yonghwa is the 2nd child who is close to noona so he sticks with her, alt between helping and harassing her.

Jungshin (not Jungsun) is the 2nd last kid... he does his own thing (eating, feeding them, whatever), they kinda forget his name or even the fact that he exists. I bet he was left behind a lot on their family trips.

Minhyuk is the baby of the family. Everyone loves him,  pampers him,  they turns feeding him even though he is an adult now and can feed himself.

And, of course, the end where they refused to leave, so they had to be kicked out. U don't do that to guests... U do that to family who is being a nuisance.

U know it's a successful mukbang when the hosts say "leave and don't come back", rather than "please come again".
